column3: The Hebrew says leaving the seventh year and the claim of every hand without explicitly naming fields or canceling debts; BSB specifies fallow fields and debt cancellation.
The Hebrew says commandments in the plural; BSB says the obligation in the singular.
The Hebrew calls the showbread bread of the arrangement; BSB says showbread.
The Hebrew repeats year in “year by year” and calls the families fathers’ houses; BSB says each year and families.
The Hebrew separately repeats every for the fruit and the trees; BSB says every fruit tree.
The Hebrew lists the first of our dough and our contributions separately; BSB applies firstfruits also to grain offerings.
The Hebrew calls the priest a son of Aaron; BSB says of Aaron’s line.
The Hebrew calls the contributors sons of Israel and sons of Levi; BSB says Israelites and Levites.
